title: Execution of a straight code segment
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $P$ a program, $l$ a list of instructions, $pc$ a program counter, and $m$ a memory. If $l$ is a prefix of the program beginning at $pc$ and every instruction in $l$ is straight (one, addition, subtraction, multiplication, load, or store), then executing $|l|$ steps from $(pc,m)$ reaches program counter $pc+|l|$ with memory obtained by applying the effects of the instructions in $l$ successively to $m$.
hypotheses_covered: l is a prefix of P.drop pc
Every instruction in l is straight
